title: The Fate of Large Scale White Noise in Second-Order Cosmological Perturbation Theory
summary: Working to second order in cosmological perturbation theory, we reconsider the Large Scale White Noise (LSWN) effect proposed in [2511.13866] and [2511.15803]. We demonstrate that the kurvature density variable $Δρ$ does indeed develop LSWN at second order. However, contrary to the claims of [2511.15803], we show that this is not inherited as an infrared (IR) pole in the second-order comoving curvature perturbation $R_2$.
